name: label
behavior: None — native <label> semantics (htmlFor/id association, or wrapping the control). Clicking or tapping transfers activation to the labelled control; the label itself is never a tab stop. It must not be replaced by a placeholder or an aria-label where a visible label is possible.

parts.statesNote: when the labelled control is disabled the label renders in content-disabled and stops forwarding pointer activation (states.md §disabled)

parts.note: the required/optional marker — an asterisk or a parenthesised word appended to the text; decorative only, the requirement itself is carried by the control's required/aria-required

anatomyNotes: Intersection of shadcn Label (Radix label root) and Salt FormFieldLabel. Salt owns the necessity marker and derives disabled from FormField context; shadcn derives disabled from a peer/group data attribute — both are WIRING differences, same two parts. Salt's intent label|sentence swaps the type role (type-label vs type-body) — a recipe difference, not an axis. Standalone label and the label part of anatomy/field.json are the same anatomy: field composes this component rather than redefining it.
